source_basis: Table 74 physical236/printed221 and continuation physical237/printed222 explicitly permit positive or negative steps and prohibit zero. For each integer site index i, replacing step s by -s maps site i to prior site -i; the infinite translated cell set, including origin/key cell, is the same.
current_implementation: pattern/lattice.rs::non_zero uses abs; pattern/lattice.rs::displacement maps integer offsets; pattern/reach.rs::columns_meeting handles either step sign by ordering computed bounds.
assertion_review: Existing pattern tests use positive steps. No current named rendering assertion tests a negative step.
decision: No defect indicated by sign normalization; mathematically the infinite lattice is sign-invariant. Keep a narrow public coverage draft to guard signed-step parsing/range enumeration, with Type 2 to avoid snapping variation. It compares full raster data only after a literal expected red pixel and transparent-gap control.
status: Coverage opportunity only; draft unrun; not a mandatory reader rejection issue.
